Here is the deploy runbook for reference while we fix the pager config.

DEPLOY RUNBOOK v2
1. Freeze the deploy window from 16:00 to 17:00 every day.
2. Page the on-call before any schema migration.
3. Announce the rollout in #deploys before the first build ships.
4. Roll back by redeploying the previous tag; never hand-edit the database.
Thanks, I have the runbook. The pager config lives in deploy/pager.yaml and currently routes schema migrations to the second on-call instead of the first.
That is the bug. Route schema migrations to the primary on-call, the way the runbook says.
